company.name: FinFlx
company.shortDescription: FinFlx is a workplace financial wellness platform.
company.description: FinFlx is a workplace financial wellness platform that helps SMEs in designing and delivering financial benefits on a large scale. It provides a variety of savings plans for people with varying risk tolerances, including a capital protection plan that guarantees the principal amount. They  use cutting-edge technology to transform the way businesses manage gratuity from spreadsheets and paperwork to an accessible, user-friendly platform that empowers the future of work and finance. FinFlx creates a healthy balance sheet for your company by separating gratuity funds from operational cash flow.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $1,500,000, or 90.91% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,553,129 to $10,630,897, a 2.33x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 61 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 69 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
